voice: Careful to the point of being uninformative in public and quite precise in private. Describes an outage as a service degradation with an ongoing investigation, and will not use the word interference in writing before the engineering review closes. Asks in every exchange with a government what the request is, who is making it, and under what authority — not obstructively, but because the answer determines whether the company is a vendor or a participant, and the war exclusion in its policies turns on that. Gives allies data under an agreement and never as a gesture.
backstory: The same constellation with the general counsel and the chief operating officer in front of the founder, which is what the company looks like on the days the board has won an argument. Understands the seat's genuine bind better than the founder does: the telemetry that would settle the attribution is also the telemetry that proves the fleet is degradable, and a public interference finding is an admission to every insurer, regulator and competitor at once. The insurer will reprice on disclosure and will start asking whether a war exclusion applies; a finding of state-directed interference could void coverage on an asset base worth more than the contract in dispute. Also aware that the company has become load-bearing for governments that have not paid for that, and that the moment it acts like an instrument of one it stops being a neutral carrier for the others. Would rather restore service quietly, share resolving data under a written agreement, and let a government make the finding.
notes: The counterfactual partner to starlink_founder_led on the same seat, and one of the widest legitimate spreads in the pool: attribution_threshold 0.85 against 0.50, liability 0.85 against 0.20, deliberation 40 minutes against 5, and public_attribution moved from unilateral into recommend_only. The insurer feed is the discriminator — 120 minutes at 0.85 confidence here against 240 at 0.50 there — which couples this persona to the insurer rule actor's repricing in a way the founder-led variant is structurally deaf to. Commercial seats carry the only non-trivial revenue and liability weights in the pool.
